descriptions.w3d_d24h_names_toggle_800c4b00: Name list toggle for the 33-byte list at +4: copies the name into a zero-digit record, scans the list, and once a record equals the name (0x802ef234) erases every record after the match; when no record matched, appends the new record, growing the list as in 0x800c47f8. Returns 0.
